name: Groovy Palette
description: Thirty more entries on the COLORS row: Amiga Workbench, the C64 boot screen, a Virtual Boy, an amber terminal, plus rainbow, fuchsia, vaporwave and the rest. USE ADVANCED rides the engine's per-tile colorization instead of replacing it, so a palette recolours eighteen colours on screen rather than flattening them to four. A START menu browser scrolls the list over the running game. PACKS narrows it to RETRO or COLOUR.
